senses.gloss: סַנֵּק same, esp. to stuff; [oth. opin.: to choke, cause loss of breath].—Part. pass. מְסַנַּק, (with ו emphat.) מְסַנְּקָן.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 3b:5">Pes. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>שויתינן … כגדי מס׳</he> you made that subject to us (as savory) as a stuffed kid; <he>כדבר אחר מ׳</he> as a stuffed swine; [Ar. a. Rashi: this lesson made us (as tired) as a breathless kid, swine].
